request: Replace blog text covers with matching photographic imagery.
method: Built-in image_gen; no API-key CLI or new external image provider.
originality: Generated/editorial symbolic imagery, not documentation of the exact merchant product or named venue.
invariants: Article copy, prices, conditions, expiry dates, title, description and canonical URLs preserved.
Printed QR, native assets, Store listings, checkout, consent, shared feed and automations unchanged.
Old cover URLs retained for external links/caches.
Full-width and 480px WebP sources; JPEG sharing fallback; lazy loading retained.
